blocks.heading: Velcro Tape
blocks.intro: Sew-on hook-and-loop fastener tape built to open and close thousands of times without losing grip — for waistbands, plackets, cuffs and closures that need to be quick and reliable.

blocks.imageAlt: Velcro hook and loop fastener tape rolls for garment closures
blocks.heading: A Fastener That Still Grips After Thousands Of Uses
blocks.html:
Velcro tape is a two-part hook-and-loop fastening system — one woven strip of fine hooks, one of soft loops — that grips on contact and releases cleanly on demand, without buttons, zips or snaps. It's a reusable closure, so the part that matters most is what happens after the first hundred uses, not just the first one.

We manufacture sew-on hook and loop tape to a consistent grip strength across the roll, so a waistband or placket closes with the same hold on use one thousand as it did on use one. Both the hook and loop strips are supplied together, cut and matched to the width your application calls for.
checklist: Consistent grip strength across thousands of open-close cycles
Sew-on hook and loop strips supplied matched and ready to stitch
Standard and custom widths, manufactured in-house in Delhi

blocks.heading: Velcro Tape FAQs
blocks.intro: Don't see your question here? Ask us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: Do you supply both the hook and loop strips together?
items.a: Yes. We supply the hook and loop strips together as a matched pair, cut to the width your closure design needs, so you're not sourcing the two sides separately.

items.q: Is sew-on or adhesive-backed better for my application?
items.a: Sew-on tape suits garments where the fastener is stitched into a seam or panel, while adhesive-backed tape suits bags, accessories and applications where sewing isn't practical. Tell us your application and we'll recommend the right type.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum quantities depend on width, colour and fastening type. Share your requirement through our contact form and we'll confirm feasible order sizes and lead time.

items.q: Does the tape hold grip after repeated washing?
items.a: Our tape is manufactured to hold grip strength through normal home and institutional laundering. For very high-wash-frequency use, let us know so we can confirm the most suitable grade.

blocks.heading: Need Velcro Tape In Bulk?
blocks.text: Tell us the width, fastening type and quantity you need — our team will respond with pricing and lead time within one business day.
